 C528 No.32 of 2025
 Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate for the applicants.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, B.H. for the State.
3.

It is contended by learned counsel for the applicants that applicant no.7 has lodged an FIR against real brother of the informant- respondent no.2 under Section 376 IPC and in that case charge sheet has been filed against the brother of the informant-respondent no.2.
4.

It is only ten days after lodging of the aforesaid FIR, proceedings were initiated in order to wreak vengeance upon the applicant and his entire family and they have been falsely implicated.
5.
I have perused the record and I find substance in the submission made by learned counsel for the applicants, therefore, the matter requires deliberation.

6. Issue notice to respondent no.2, returnable within six weeks.
7. Steps to be taken within a week.
8.
9. Counter affidavit be filed by the respondents, in between.

10. In the meantime, proceedings of Criminal Case No.1454 of 2024 (Case Crime No.1142 of 2022),
State Vs. Sarvar Khan and others, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate/Ist Additional Civil Judge, Roorkee, District Haridwar, shall remain stayed.
